plugins.title: Web UI 全家桶 (dsh-web-ui-all)
plugins.description: One-click install of the whole dsh-web-ui family: SSH operations, the task board, the right-hand panel, skins, and more.
plugins.descriptionZh: 一键装齐整个 dsh-web-ui 家族：SSH 运维、任务看板、右侧面板、皮肤等。

plugins.title: SSH 远程运维 (dsh-ssh)
plugins.description: Manage remote hosts: host configuration, persistent connections, exec/upload/download, tunnels, and a web terminal.
plugins.descriptionZh: 远程主机运维：主机配置、持久连接、执行命令、上传下载、隧道与 Web 终端。

plugins.title: 任务看板 (dsh-task-board)
plugins.description: A multi-column task board whose tasks really execute, with cron scheduling.
plugins.descriptionZh: 多列任务看板，任务可真实执行，支持 cron 定时调度。

plugins.title: 实时状态 (dsh-live-stats)
plugins.description: Live runtime statistics for the harness.
plugins.descriptionZh: 展示 harness 的实时运行统计。

plugins.title: 桌面宠物 (dsh-pet)
plugins.description: A desktop pet companion for the Web GUI.
plugins.descriptionZh: Web GUI 里的桌面宠物伙伴。

plugins.title: 远程 Web UI (dsh-remote-web-ui)
plugins.description: Remote Web UI capabilities with settings integration.
plugins.descriptionZh: 远程 Web UI 能力，带设置集成。

plugins.title: 皮肤中心 (dsh-skins)
plugins.description: The skin center: themes and appearance assets for the Web GUI.
plugins.descriptionZh: 皮肤中心：Web GUI 的主题与外观资源。
